films.title: L'Odissea
films.description: Rossi's Telemachy keeps Nestor's household at Pylos — Polycaste among the Neleid daughters who host Odysseus' son before the road to Sparta.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer's Polycaste, youngest daughter of Nestor, bathes Telemachus at Pylos and dresses him in a tunic and cloak — the Neleid hostess of the Telemachy.

popCulture.title: Polycaste
popCulture.description: Daughter of Nestor — later tradition sometimes makes her mother of Persepolis by Telemachus.

popCulture.title: Telemachus
popCulture.description: The guest Polycaste bathes — Odysseus' son whose Pylian welcome opens the search for his father.

popCulture.title: Nestor
popCulture.description: Polycaste's father — the aged counselor whose daughter completes the hospitality of Odyssey 3.
